name: wiki-mind
description: wiki-mind's own extension in real sessions: the session-start sections, the Stop checklist and detectors, the prompt signals and the §2 write validators, on both arms, and across a compaction, where the settings path falls back to pointers and the mod keeps the full context. The fixtures are a tiny wiki with one note per folder and deliberate drift (an unsourced concept, a one-sided synthesis, an entity Index.md doesn't annotate) and one open question.
